Author: R.Hemalatha

 The Honourable Mrs.Justice R.Hemalatha

 and

 2.Sivan Tobacco Company,

 Gandhiji New Road,
 Dindigul-624001. ... Petitio
 Vs
 State Represented by
 The Food Safety Officer,
 Code No.412,
 Dindigul Town,
 Dindigul District. ... Responden
 Prayer: Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of the C
 Criminal Procedure to call for the records in C.C.No.452 of 2020 on

 Crl Op(
 For Petitioners : Mr.S.Sarvagan Prabhu
 For Respondent : Mr.R.M.Anbunithi
 Additional Public Prosecutor
 Order
The present petition is filed to call for the records in C.C.No.452 of 2020 on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate No.III, Dindigul and quash the same insofar as the petitioners are concerned. 
2. Mr.R.M.Anbunithi, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent, on instructions, would contend that the petitioners were convicted on 16.08.2022 by the learned Judicial Magistrate No.III, Dindigul and therefore, nothing survives for further adjudication. 
3. Recording the said submission, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed. Consequently,
connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
